translation: Non-toxic. It stops wasting-thirst [消渴], excessive salivation, great abdominal dribbling urination, phlegm and water in the diaphragm, edema and strangury binding, opens the chest and bowels, harmonizes visceral qi, attacks kidney evil, [strengthens] yin, boosts qi and strength, and protects the spirit and guards the center. That which has roots is called Fushen [茯神].
